resolution_rule: Evaluate every branch inequality against the official first-release values, using z = (actual minus the frozen expectation) / frozen spread. A call triggers only when all its conditions hold. Measure the directional percent move from the first recorded price at or after the release through the frozen plan exit. Resolve a hit only if the minimum move occurs before invalidation and by that exit; otherwise resolve invalidated, not reached, or not triggered as applicable. Missing prices or unknown ordering remain unresolved. The naive baseline uses CC-011 D1 close-to-close percent betas, includes the day's other news, and is not rescaled to the plan horizon.
